t: Importation Of Munitions Of War Into Shanghai During 1931-32

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
N. D 4815
Date 29 / 4 / 33

April 27 33

CONFIDENTIAL

Dear Holcomb,

I have to state that inquiries have been
made regarding the importation of munitions of war
into Shanghai during 1931 and 1932, but without success.
I attach herewith for your confidential information
a list of munitions imported into Shanghai since
April 1932 which have been temporarily stored in
the Customs Magazine, Lay Road, Settlement. There
is good reason to believe that the items on this
list only constitute a small percentage of the
actual amount imported during the period mentioned.

Yours sincerely,

〔此处为手写签名〕

Lieut. B.T. Holcomb,
U.S.Marine Corps.

〔此处有手写批注及签名，难以辨认〕

Note
Customs Returns of Arms & Ammunition
for the years 1928 to 1930 are filed in the
Secretariat S.M.C.
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处
编号 N. D 4815
日期 33年4月29日

1933年4月27日

机密

霍尔科姆（Holcomb）先生：

兹声明，虽已就1931年及1932年间军火输入上海一事进行调查，但未有收获。现随函附上自1932年4月以来输入上海并暂存于租界雷路（Lay Road）海关仓库的军火清单，供你方机密参考。有充分理由相信，该清单所列物品仅占上述期间实际输入总量的一小部分。

此致

〔此处为手写签名〕

B.T. 霍尔科姆中尉，
美国海军陆战队。

〔此处有手写批注及签名，难以辨认〕

附注
1928年至1930年的武器弹药海关报表存档于工部局秘书处。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.__________

S.I, Special branch Section
REPORT CONFIDENTIAL Date April 26, 1933

Subject (in full) Importation of munitions of war into Shanghai
during 1931/2.

Made by D.S.I. Duncan    Forwarded by Thos Rubertson Supt.

Enquiries have been made with a view to
obtaining information regarding the importation of munitions
of war into Shanghai in 1931/2 but without success.
Attached is a list of munitions imported into
Shanghai since April 1932 and temporary if stored in the
Lay Road Customs Magazine. It is, however, known that
this is but a very small percentage of the actual amount
imported during that period.

W Duncan.
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

File 9/5

特别股情报科
机密报告 日期 1933年4月26日

主题（全称） 1931/2年间军火输入上海情况。

由特别股督察邓肯（Duncan）撰写 由警司托马斯·鲁伯特森（Thos Rubertson）转呈

为获取1931/2年间军火输入上海的相关信息，已进行查询，但未获成功。附件为自1932年4月以来输入上海并暂存于雷路海关仓库的军火清单。然而，众所周知，这仅是该期间实际输入量的极小一部分。

W. 邓肯
特别股督察

特别股主管警官
